learning_outcomes.text: Ability to perform simulations using created system models and analyze system behavior.
Ability to design a control loop to control relevant variables in systems.
Ability to decide what kind of equipment to use and how to select it when designing a control loop.
Ability to recognize controllers, adjust controllers, and analyze their performance on systems.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts and necessity of process control
Solving linear differential equations using Laplace transforms
Linearization and simulation of non-linear systems
Processes with dead time and inverse response
Investigation of control loop stability and performance
